context.note: Analyzer failures are dominated by legacy Mix v1 APIs across example widgets (704 issues) and core library code (251 issues), plus missing lint includes.

task.title: Realign Moon Core Mix abstractions with Mix v2 Spec→Mix→Styling pattern
task.description: Refactor core mix attributes, modifiers, and DTOs to match Mix v2 generics and lifecycle so that legacy DTO types and superclasses compile again.
task.docs: <doc path=".llms/token-migration-guide.md:11" summary="Explains new MixToken contracts needed by attributes and modifiers."/>

steps.step: Audit each custom DTO/modifier to replace removed `MixableFieldDto` usage with the new `MixableFieldType`/Prop APIs described in Mix v2.
Judge if usage of current custom DTOs/modifiers can be simplified or eliminated by leveraging new Mix v2 features.
If previous step is not successful proceed with implementing dedicated `*Mix` classes (e.g., `IconMix`, `TextMix`, `BoxMix`) and update corresponding styling factories per consolidation plan phases.
Reconcile modifier constructors with updated annotations/utilities so that generated code and runtime behavior align with Mix v2 expectations.
Determine if there are any custom DTOs/modifiers that got superceded by v2 features and if they are unused remove them.

task.title: Migrate Moon widgets to BoxMix/TextMix/IconMix usage
task.description: Update Moon widget implementations that still depend on `Style`, `$on`, and other Mix v1 helpers to the new fluent Mix builders and token-based styling.

doc.summary: Shows BoxMix sizing and chaining in Mix v2.
Example of applying tokens within new styler APIs.

steps.step: Replace legacy `Style`/`$box` constructs in widget defaults with `BoxMix`/`TextMix` equivalents, preserving variants via new builder APIs.
Rewrite state handling (`MixWidgetStateController`, `$on`) to use updated variant/state APIs supported by Mix v2 or create compatibility shims.
Adapt widget constructors to accept new mix types (e.g., `BoxMix? style`) and update downstream usage/tests accordingly.

task.title: Update MoonBorder to extended Mix v2 border contracts
task.description: Resolve inheritance and override errors in `MoonBorder` by aligning with the current `MixOutlinedBorder` (or replacement) APIs shipped with Mix v2.

doc.summary: Phase guidance covering spec updates for icons/box that also apply to border specs.

steps.step: Inspect the Mix v2 border base classes and update MoonBorder to extend the correct type and override the supported methods only.
Refactor associated DTOs and serialization (`moon_border_dto`) to use the new prop/value registration patterns.
Write regression tests covering painting, lerp, and DTO round-trips under the updated API.

task.title: Adopt MixToken-driven theming across Moon components
task.description: Ensure tokens and scopes in Moon core and examples use the new `MixToken` reference/resolve workflow to unlock Mix v2 theme resolution.

doc.summary: Defines new token classes and reference helpers.
Guides MixScope configuration with typed token maps.

steps.step: Replace deprecated token DTO usages with concrete `MixToken` declarations and update scope provisioning to typed maps.
Audit styling code for direct color/space constants and swap to token calls to align with v2 references.
Update documentation and examples to reflect token-first usage, verifying analyzer passes without deprecated member warnings.

task.title: Rewrite example styled components for Mix v2 API
task.description: Port all example `Style`/`$on` driven components to the new spec/mix syntax so the example app compiles and serves as migration guidance.

doc.summary: BoxMix usage example for constraints and chaining.
Hands-on tutorial for tokens and scopes to mirror in examples.

steps.step: Define shared Mix v2 styles (`BoxMix`, `TextMix`, etc.) in `common_styles.dart` and refactor each component to consume them.
Update state/variant handling to new APIs, ensuring hover/press/dark modes use the supported variant syntax.
Run example app builds (`flutter run`) to validate runtime behavior once analyzer issues are cleared.

task.title: Restore CI signals after migration
task.description: Re-enable analyzer and tests once code compiles under Mix v2 by wiring lint tooling and running targeted suites.

doc.summary: Recommends running tests after each migration phase.

steps.step: Execute `dart analyze` and `flutter test -r expanded` locally to confirm zero diagnostics post-migration.
Document migration steps and outcomes in CHANGELOG and project docs for team onboarding.
